title: flowable_dmn_deploy input
description: Arguments of the MCP tool flowable_dmn_deploy: one decision resource passed inline instead of the multipart upload of POST /flowable/dmn_deployments/upload.

name.description: File name including the extension .dmn (or .bar/.zip for an archive).

content.description: File content: the DMN XML as text, or base64 with contentEncoding "base64" (required for .bar/.zip).

contentEncoding.description: Set to "base64" when content is base64-encoded.

deploymentName.description: Deployment name (defaults to the file name).

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector (full or partial UUID). Omit to use the default engine connection.
